title: Linkfile configuration
description: The single source of truth for a Linkfile profile page. Editing this file is the entire CMS.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file. Enables validation and autocomplete in editors such as VS Code.

name.description: Display name shown as the page heading.

handle.description: Short handle shown under the name, for example "@alexbuilds".

bio.description: One or two sentences describing you.

avatar.description: Path to an image inside /public, for example "/avatar.svg".

location.description: Optional location line, for example "Toronto, Canada".

accent.description: Optional accent colour as a 3, 6 or 8 digit hex value. Defaults to #1d4ed8.

showBranding.description: Show the small "Built with Linkfile" footer. Defaults to true.

metadata.description: Page metadata used for the browser tab, search engines and social previews.

title.description: Page title, also used in the generated Open Graph image.

description.description: Meta description and social preview subtitle.

links.description: Ordered list of links. The array order is the order shown on the page.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier used for /go/<slug> and click statistics. Must be unique.

title.description: Button label shown on the page.

url.description: Destination. Only https:, http: and mailto: are allowed.

emoji.description: Optional decorative emoji shown before the title.
